content_sections.heading: About CURAJ
content_sections.text: The Central University of Rajasthan is located at Bandarsindri in Ajmer district, Rajasthan. This post sits in the Department of Chemistry, part of the university's School of Chemical Sciences and Pharmacy. The selected candidate will work on the ANRF-funded Advanced Research Grant (ARG) project titled "Rational Design and Development of Earth-abundant Iron-based Catalysts for Sustainable Borylation". The project is sanctioned to Dr. Chandrakanta Dash, Assistant Professor in the department.

content_sections.heading: CURAJ JRF and Project Associate-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is as per ANRF norms. M.Sc. Chemistry/Inorganic/Organic (minimum 55% or equivalent CGPA). Valid NET-JRF/GATE/NET required for JRF. Working experience in the area of synthetic Organic/Inorganic Chemistry. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted, and only shortlisted candidates are called for the interview. The interview is held in the Department of Chemistry at the Central University of Rajasthan campus. Its date will be notified separately. Original mark sheets and relevant educational certificates of the selected candidate are verified before the position is offered. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates appearing for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely contractual. The tenure is one year from the date of appointment, with a possibility of extension based on the candidate's performance and availability of funds. After receiving the appointment letter, the selected candidate must join in person at the university for the fellowship to take effect.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CURAJ JRF and Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV and educational certificates from the 10th class onwards. Address the application to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Chandrakanta Dash, and email it to [email protected] . Clearly mention "Application for the position of JRF/Project Associate-I under ANRF-ARG Project" in the subject line. Send the email on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. Is NET or GATE compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: The notice requires a valid NET-JRF, GATE or NET for JRF. It lists this requirement for JRF only.

faq.question: Q2. What percentage is needed in the M.Sc.?
faq.answer: A minimum of 55% or equivalent CGPA is required.

faq.question: Q3. Is research experience mandatory?
faq.answer: No. Working experience in synthetic Organic/Inorganic Chemistry is listed as desirable, not essential.

faq.question: Q4. Why are two pay figures given?
faq.answer: The pay depends on the position: Rs. 37,000 + HRA a month for JRF and Rs. 31,000 + HRA a month for Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q5. What should I attach to the email?
faq.answer: Attach your CV and your educational certificates from the 10th class onwards.

faq.question: Q6. What should the email subject line say?
faq.answer: It should read "Application for the position of JRF/Project Associate-I under ANRF-ARG Project".

faq.question: Q7. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: It will be held in the Department of Chemistry on the university campus. Only shortlisted candidates will be called.

faq.question: Q8. Can the one-year tenure be extended?
faq.answer: Yes, an extension is possible based on the candidate's performance and availability of funds.

faq.question: Q9. Will the university tell me if I am not shortlisted?
faq.answer: The notice says no communications will be entertained about being called or not called, or selected or not selected.
